[LFCA.2.1] The action-level construct capabilities. A construct whose
capability the program's resolved settings set `false` is refused ([LDIA.3.4.2]).

| Name | Explanation | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|
| `call` | `call <domain>.<method> ...` action — async invocation of a service hosted by an adapter or an integrator-registered call target, with a fact of the service's response schema arriving as the response | not generally avoidable. If disabled, rules cannot reach any service or adapter action. Move the rule to a tier where `call` is enabled. |
| `publish` | `publish <Schema> ...` — cross-tier upward fact flow with TTL / overflow policy | move the rule to a non-topmost tier. |
| `cache` | `cache key: <k> value: <v>` — write to the cache plane | keep the state in a `logical` fact instead. Reads are unaffected: `cached(...)` is not gateable ([LFCA.2.4]). |
| `cache_delete` | `cache_delete key: <k>` | use `cache` with a short TTL. Loses explicit invalidation. |
